notes.title: Update: Clam Nerf and Earlier Level Unlocks
notes.content:
Levels now unlock upon reaching Wave 6 instead of reaching the Boss Wave.

Additionally, the Clam in Level 1 has had its rate of fire and projectile speed reduced.

- hoontee

notes.title: Update: Co-op Quality of Life improvements
notes.content:
In co-op mode, players will now respawn with half health at the start of the wave if they died, assuming their partner is still alive.

Also, players will be now become invincible for a short time after warping, which happens when the player without the camera focus travels off-screen.

Co-op gameplay should definitely be more manageable now. For those of you that play the co-op mode, I hope you enjoy these changes!

- hoontee

notes.title: Update: Mouse support for menus
notes.content:
Mouse support has been added for all in-game menus!

Left click to advance and right click to go back.

Albeit a small change, hopefully this makes the experience all the more enjoyable.

- hoontee

notes.title: Aquarius is going Free!
notes.content:
On December 14th, Aquarius will become free to play! Not without a few changes though:

[list]
[*] I'm currently hard at work on my next game, Putt Putt Planet (working title.) Aquarius has been updated to include an invite to the [url=https://discord.gg/n33vdDr]official Iron Stag Games Discord server[/url] inside the main menu.

[*] Additionally, I will be adding banner advertisements to the game-over screen for Putt Putt Planet and any future games of mine. They will be added after those games have launched.
[/list]

Thank you to all of the users who bought the game - you will certainly be awarded appropriately for your early support, so stay tuned (and do join the Discord server!)

- hoontee
